title: Pushout of a fixed-object coproduct after replacing one factor
statement: Let $O$ be a small set and let $F,A,V$ be small ordinary categories [def-nagata-category] with object set $O$. All functors fix $O$. Write $F*_O A$ and $F*_O V$ for coproducts in the category of small categories with object set $O$ and functors equal to the identity on $O$, and let $v:A\to V$ be a functor. Form the pushout $P=(F*_O A)\amalg_A V$ of the coproduct inclusion $A\to F*_O A$ and $v$ in that fixed-object category. Write $a:F*_O A\to P$ and $b:V\to P$ for the pushout structure functors. The canonical functor $F*_O V\to P$, induced by the composite $F\to F*_O A\xrightarrow{a}P$ and by $b$, is an isomorphism. Under this isomorphism the pushout structure map from $F*_O A$ restricts to the inclusion of $F$ and sends the $A$ factor through $v$ into $V$; equivalently, functors from $P$ to any fixed-object category are exactly pairs of functors from $F$ and $V$ agreeing on $O$.

lean.statement: theorem fixed_object_scat_pushout_coproduct {O : Type u} (F A V P : Category.{v} O) (v : A ⟶ V) (cFA : BinaryCofan F A) (hcFA : IsColimit cFA) (cFV : BinaryCofan F V) (hcFV : IsColimit cFV) (a : cFA.pt ⟶ P) (b : V ⟶ P) (p : IsPushout cFA.inr v a b) : ∃ e : cFV.pt ≅ P, e.hom = pushoutComparison cFA cFV hcFV a b ∧ a ≫ e.inv = BinaryCofan.IsColimit.desc hcFA cFV.inl (v ≫ cFV.inr) ∧ b ≫ e.inv = cFV.inr
lean.note: The recorded Mathlib match CategoryTheory.IsPushout.of_coprod_inl_with_id supplies the abstract pushout calculation, but the repository has no category of categories on a literally fixed object type to specialize it to, nor the canonical specialized comparison with its restrictions. This module supplies that category and states the canonical comparison with its inverse restrictions, using Mathlib BinaryCofan, IsColimit, IsPushout and Iso throughout. The existing fixedObjectCategoryCoproduct is a chosen pushout in Cat, with a different object type and no fixed-object category interface; it is not a substitute for these strict fixed-object homs.
